description: The IDCore 30 Cryptographic Library v1.6 operates on the Infineon SLE78 (M7892 & M7820) chip family, targeting Javacard 2.2.2, GP 2.1.1 & GP 2.2 Amdt D compliant modules. The library implements TDEA, AES, AES-CMAC, SHA1-224-256-384-512, RSA, RSA CRT, ECDSA, ECC CDH and ANSI X9.31 RNG algorithms.
